title: Untimed bitstring command request
purpose: Exercise the shorter bitstring command path with a distinct type identifier and reduced ASDU length.
expected_behavior: The receiver should parse a valid untagged bitstring command activation and process or acknowledge it according to configured IEC60870 control behavior without process termination.
constraints_preserved: The APCI length 0x11 represents four APCI control bytes plus a 13-byte ASDU.
The ASDU type identifier 51 denotes C_BO_NA_1 according to supplied function-code documentation.
The ASDU uses VSQ 1, COT 6, common address 1, one three-byte information object address, and a four-byte bitstring command value.
APCI I-format control-field ordering and sequence-number semantics are inferred from widely recognized IEC 60870-5-104 framing and are not independently verified by the supplied excerpts.
issue_safety_notes: This seed uses issue 13 only as structural parser-risk guidance. It is not the historical crash payload and differs in ASDU type, APDU length, and field composition.
